test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

All the companies make an __________ to be seen and heard within communities.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Effort**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank requires a noun that fits the context of companies wanting to be noticed in communities.
 
• The sentence is discussing the actions that companies take to become noticeable and gain attention within communities.
 
• Effort means something that is done with difficulty or that takes a lot of energy. (कठिनाई से या बहुत शक्ति लगाकर किया जाने वाला काम)
 
• The word "**effort**" fits well in this context because it refers to the attempt, work, or endeavour that companies put into achieving their goal of being visible and heard within communities.
 
• It conveys the idea that companies are actively working and taking steps to create a presence and establish a connection within the local communities.
 
• Therefore, "**effort**" accurately represents the action that companies are undertaking in order to achieve their aim.

Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Establishment **refers to the act of setting up or founding something, which does not fit the context of the sentence. (किसी चीज की स्थापना या स्थापना करने की क्रिया या भाव)
 
• Excuse means a reason or justification for something, which is the opposite of what companies would want to make in this context. (किसी बात का कारण या औचित्य)
 
• **Aisle **refers to a passage between rows of seats or shelves, which also does not fit the context of the sentence. (सीटों या अलमारियों की पंक्तियों के बीच का मार्ग)
